design: Freeze the original V49 backbone and logits, not failed V51 weights. Add a zero-initialized candidate-geometry residual. A linear layer of frozen recurrent state and predicted soft code outputs geometry coefficients; matched control substitutes the fitting training mean code. All causal PRE entity geometry, static-terrain distances and first-step masks are identical across arms. No hindsight code or endpoint labels enter inputs.
targets: Current known alive nearest/weakest camp and enemy, nearest ally, nearest public altar, fixed public home/enemy-home central tile. These are input features, not objective labels. Static eight-neighbor terrain progress is available for altar/home targets only; entity progress uses current geometric distance. Unknown entity dynamic fields are ignored. No future blocker or legality claim.
data: All1607 existing fitting windows from32games; four whole-game folds. Fold backbone is matching V49 checkpoint. Held fold validates only its original64windows. No hindsight code labels, movement labels, future descriptors, identity or direction diagnostics enter inputs.
loss: Supported movement cross entropy, divided by actual movement rows in each32-window batch. No movement rows means skip update. Same permutations/updates across arms. No recurrent updates.
selection: One shared epoch for both arms selected by maximum sum of held-fitting correct moves, then minimum summed NLL, then earlier epoch; epochs0,8,...64 eligible. Refit both on all fitting windows from the full V49 backbone; evaluate selected pair once.
success: Usable movement improvement: predicted arm gains at least3percentage points vsV49, accuracy at least originalS01, and NLL at most0.01 worse than either. Additional code benefit: at least1percentage point above constant control and strictly lower NLL. Report all group/direction/code strata, paired rescues/regressions, and code/goal parity. These are allocation thresholds, not statistical significance or promotion.
limitations: Previously exposed research groups, original backbone/discovery fitting-group exposure, teacher-forced history, inferred labels, conditional movement only. No strategy or playing-strength claim. No subagents or playing-bot changes. Original checkpoints preserved. Follow-up after exposed negative V51; not a fresh confirmatory study.
